part: PEM FH/FHS/FHA/FH4/FHP/FHL/FHLS/TFH flush-head self-clinching studs bulletin FH (key-plate M2.5 studs)
notes: PEM bulletin FH, footer 2/16/26, 36 pp, full text layer. NO M2 in any flush-head table: FH/FHS/FHA metric start at M2.5 (FH-5), FHL/FHLS at M2.5 (FH-7), FH4/FHP and TFH/TFHS at M3 (FH-6, FH-8). There is no 'FHA-M2' and no FHP/FHL thin-sheet M2. FH-5 M2.5: min sheet 1, hole 2.5 +0.08, H (head dia) 4.1 +/-0.4, S max 1.95, max hole in attached parts 3.1, min hole C/L to edge 5.4, L 6/8/10/12/15/18 +/-0.4; L and S are measured from the head face (flush with sheet top). #2-56 is FH/FHS only (no FHA): .040/.085/.144/.075/.105/.187. Hardness: FH HRB 80/HB 150, FHS HRB 70/HB 125, FHA (aluminium sheet only) HRB 50/HB 82. FHL-M2.5 (FH-7): hole 2.5, H 3.15, S 2.1, edge 2.8. Anvil for sheets <=1.5 mm is the countersunk H-103-M2.5LC / 970200493300 (FH-18). Perf FH-29 M2.5 in 1.6 mm Al: FH 0.78 N-m nut, 8.9 kN install, 465 N pushout, 1.0 N-m torque-out. FH-30: FHA has NO M2.5 performance row. FH-31 FHL/FHLS M2.5 in 1.2 mm Al HRB 33: 0.32 N-m, 3.1 kN, 285 N, 0.55 N-m. Superseded copy at .../sites/9/2022/06/fhdata.pdf (footer 12/07/21, sha256 ab2187c3...) not banked; it also has no M2. Head height and post-install flushness tolerance are NOT published.

part: PEM tech sheet 'Choosing a Fastener Finish' (galvanic: steel/stainless studs in aluminium panel)
notes: PEM REF tech sheet, July 2019, 9 pp. The FH bulletin itself has no galvanic note; this does. p3 Section B: aluminium panel + 300-series stainless fastener = 'significant galvanic potential voltage difference', a problem only if an electrolyte is present; remedy is plating (zinc 'greatly reduces the potential difference'); plated stainless must be a special. p4 Section C: aluminium panel + steel fastener with standard zinc finish, difference 'greatly reduced and may be acceptable'. p3 Section A: FHA (heat-treatable alloy) is slightly more noble than 5000-series panel alloys.
